integrity: Four complete rational graded Betti vectors and the sharp two-pair finite graph census are supported by the standalone exact-arithmetic verifier and an independently implemented rational-rank cross-check.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive connected simple unicyclic graphs through six vertices only; rational Betti numbers, no integral torsion, cup products or infinite-order recurrence; independent validation and global literature priority not established.
title: First degree–Tutte twins in unicyclic graph-nilmanifold cohomology
